The time of the 25 Years of Tibia Quest + 1 min for the addons

The {wiki:Formal Dress Outfits|Formal Dress Outfit} is the reward for defeating {creature:Lord Retro} at the end of the {wiki:25 Years of Tibia Quest}. The two addons (the tailcoat and the hat) are unlocked by using a {item:Brass Button} and a {item:Decorative Plume}. With both addons you get the achievement **Sharp Dressed**.
Thais northeast tower (Time Travel Dungeon entrance)
The dangers are those of the {wiki:25 Years of Tibia Quest}: the 'Memory' creatures and the boss {creature:Lord Retro}.
Getting to the Time Travel Dungeon

The fight against {creature:Lord Retro} is at the end of the {wiki:Time Travel Dungeon}. In **Thais**, go to the **northeast** wall tower ({coord:32427,32171,7}) and go down the stairs. Down there is a teleport machine (the time machine, {coord:32429,32168,8}): use it to enter the dungeon. The full route to the boss (photo album, blue fire and the {npc:MUD}) is explained in the guide to the {wiki:25 Years of Tibia Quest}.

During the fight there is a teleport **north** of the room that takes you out of the fight (do not enter it before it is over). After the boss, go back through the dungeon's teleports to the entrance and use the time machine to return to the northeast tower of **Thais**; the machine only works for leaving after you have repaired it during the {wiki:25 Years of Tibia Quest}. Next time, the purple teleport in the {creature:Memory of a Werelion} room works as a shortcut to near Lord Retro's teleport.
Use a {item:Brass Button}. The message *"You may wear the tailcoat now."* appears.
Use a {item:Decorative Plume}. The message *"You may wear the hat now."* appears. After using both items you receive the **Sharp Dressed** achievement.
